# hand

Computer-use library. A device lists the controls on screen, Clef (a small Cloudflare model) picks one with a probability, the device acts, and Clef checks the result. Clef and Clairic never write text. A writer model fills fields only when the task needs new text.

Install: bun add github:acoyfellow/hand#release

Setup (macOS, Bun, a Cloudflare account):
1. Credentials: {"accountId": "<id>", "gateway": "default"} in ~/.config/hand/config.json, and the API token (Workers AI: Read, AI Gateway: Run) in the Keychain: security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s hand-gateway -w. Or set HAND_ACCOUNT_ID, HAND_GATEWAY, HAND_TOKEN.
2. bunx hand doctor: checks credentials, builds the macOS helper into ~/.config/hand/bin/ax (needs xcode-select --install, or set HAND_AX_HELPER to the prebuilt helper from the releases page), checks Accessibility (required) and Screen Recording (only for look and screenshots), and prints the fix for anything missing. Permissions go to the app that runs hand; restart it after granting.
3. MCP config: {"command": "bunx", "args": ["hand", "mcp"], "env": {"HAND_HEADED": "1"}}

Import paths: hand/hand, hand/devices/macos, hand/clef, hand/clairic, hand/writer, hand/steer, hand/llm, hand/perceive, hand/credentials, hand/helper, hand/mcp.

Use from code on a Mac:
```ts
import { gatewayTransport } from 'hand/clef';
import { readConfig, readToken } from 'hand/credentials';
import { macosDevice } from 'hand/devices/macos';
import { Hand } from 'hand/hand';
import { helperOrBuild } from 'hand/helper';
const transport = gatewayTransport({ ...readConfig(), token: readToken() });
const device = macosDevice({ helper: helperOrBuild(), app: 'Google Chrome', headed: true, allowMouse: true });
const hand = new Hand(transport, device, { model: 'clef', method: 'ax_text', tau: 0.3, riskTau: 0.5, injectionTau: 0.5, verify: true });
await hand.outline();                          // controls with ids like [e3], plus the text on screen
await hand.act('switch to the termlab tab');   // Clef picks, device presses via accessibility, returns a receipt
await hand.type('coey.dev', 'the address bar'); // focus, select all, real keystrokes to that app only
await hand.select('Japanese', 'language');
await hand.look('is coey.dev open?');           // p(yes)
```
macOS device rules: headless by default, so press and type go through accessibility only, and keystroke or mouse steps are refused with POLICY_DENIED. Many real tasks need them (typing into a Notes body, renaming in Finder, web controls with no accessibility action), so turn on headed mode: HAND_HEADED=1 for the MCP server, or macosDevice({ headed: true, allowMouse: true }). type sets the value and reads the field back. STALE_REF means the control changed since the snapshot: call outline() again. Pass agent: 'id' so parallel agents take turns on a shared lock (LEASE_TIMEOUT after 10 s). device.receipts lists every action with delivery (delivered_verified | delivered_unverified | not_delivered), mechanism (semantic_api | physical_synthetic | none), retrySafe and code; onAction gives before/after events.

MCP server (macOS, stdio): bunx hand mcp (HAND_HEADED=1 to allow keystrokes and mouse). Tools: apps, activate, outline, act {app, intent, confirm?, agent?}, type {app, text, into, mode?: replace|insert, agent?}, key {app, key, agent?}, steps {app, steps[], agent?} (stops at the first unsure, blocked or failed step), look {app, question}. Actions are also sent as notifications/message with logger hand.action.

Hand receipts start with "Clicked", "Typed", "UNSURE" (did not act) or "BLOCKED" (looks destructive; pass confirm=true only if the user asked).

Writer (swappable): writerFromSpec(transport, 'glm-5.3-flash>kimi-k2.6')({ task, fields: [{ key, label, role }] }) returns { values, costUsd, ms, fellBack }. glm writes first; when it leaves a field empty and Clef says the task needs new text, kimi fills only that field. 42-43/44 on the writer eval at $0.00009/case.

Device contract (implement this to support a new screen):
```ts
interface Device {
  viewport(): { width: number; height: number };
  screenshot(clip?: Box): Promise<string>;           // data URL
  marked(cands: Candidate[]): Promise<string>;
  gridShot(region: Box, n?: number): Promise<{ img: string; cells: Record<string, Box> }>;
  candidates(): Promise<Candidate[]>;                // { id, role, name, x, y, w, h, backendNodeId }
  click(p: { x: number; y: number }): Promise<void>;
  press?(c: Candidate): Promise<void>;               // preferred over click when present
  typeInto(c: Candidate, text: string): Promise<void>;
  setValue(c: Candidate, value: string): Promise<boolean>;
  settle(): Promise<void>;
}
```

Bench: bench/, bun run gate (fails if results are stale or worse than bench/baseline.json). Not included: CLI, desktop tasks in the bench, Windows/Linux devices.

Ids: act and type take an id from the last outline (for example act('e3')) or plain words. An id whose control changed since that outline returns STALE_REF; call outline() again.

Lab: hand.coey.dev/lab compares hand with agent-browser, Playwright MCP, Stagehand, browser-use and agent-desktop on the same tasks and planner.
